note: Document-level relevance labels for the frozen corpus in eval/index, made by Claude Code on 2026-10-19 by reading the full text of all 80 documents. A document is relevant if it contains information that helps answer the question, not merely a passing mention. Split: the first 10 questions were inspected while building retrieval and are dev; the 30 added later were split 10 dev / 20 test by a seeded shuffle before any retrieval was run on them. Tune on dev; score test only to confirm a configuration. Revisions: after a full-text reread, the methane-vs-CO2 question gained wb_P508792 (GWP-based CO2e conversion) and the NDC-tracking question gained four documents describing MRV or emissions-inventory systems. Judgement calls; review before relying on them.
